time_code_block: use the timing.time context manager to measure execution time of a code block
time_function_decorator: use the timing.time decorator to measure execution time of a function
create_timing_snapshot: create a timing snapshot with timing.snapshot to capture performance metrics at a point in time
report_timing_snapshot: call timing.report to print a formatted table of all recorded timing statistics
format_duration: use the format_time function to convert seconds into a human readable duration string
